prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 84.8%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 23.5%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Interactive Story Scroll Experience for Path Selection: Redesign the path selection step into a story-driven scroll layout where user choices dynamically update visual mascot character previews. (why: choose_path has a high mean duration of 514s and 23.8% drop-off; a story scroll layout increases engagement and decision speed.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet AI Generation Progress Visualizer: Introduce a dedicated preview screen right after custom photo upload to show visual progress during photo processing. (why: Adoption step has a high drop-off rate (31.1%) and users reported custom pet creation stalling or looking incorrect.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign In Before Certificate Finalization: Place sign-in immediately after pick_friend/upload_photos and before adoption_certificate so accounts are created before generating official pet records. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in later, and linking account before adoption certificate locks in pet data.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Restore Security Hint: Display a explicit hint under sign-in options confirming that returning users will automatically keep all previously adopted pets. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or resetting upon re-signing in.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Pre-made vs Custom Path Outcome Clarity Body: Clarify the choose_path body text to explain instant pre-made pet activation versus custom photo pet creation time. (why: Median time on choose_path is 8s but mean is 514s, indicating uncertainty about what each path entails.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Mascot Arrival Status Message: Update waiting screen status body with clear assurances about background rendering and display preparation. (why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s and 3 users reported pet display bugs on initial desktop launch.)
6: [adoption, layout] Stage Layout for Adoption Certificate Final Step: Transform the adoption certificate step into a stage layout featuring an official adoption badge stamp component. (why: Adoption has the highest conversion drop (68.9% conversion), making the step visually rewarding encourages completion.)
7: [home, notification] Desktop System Tray Ready Ping Toggle: Enable notify_when_ready on the waiting screen so users get a desktop notification when background pet generation completes. (why: Home waiting stage has a mean time of 2336s (38+ min), causing users to abandon the app while waiting.)
